body_definition: 正文从摘要结束后的下一页开始，到参考文献标题前一页结束；附录不计入正文。

internal_total_page_target.note: 这是内部写作目标，不是官方页数要求。仅在每问证据链闭合且图表不重复时追求；未达到时先审计证据缺口，禁止用套话、重复图表、放大图表、强制分页或无效模型凑页。

policy: As of 2026-09-21, reviewed official materials state no body minimum, body maximum, or total-page maximum. Official page gates and historical role windows are disabled by default. The 50-page value is a user-requested, evidence-conditional internal target for the complete physical PDF, never an official requirement or permission to pad.
